correctness.rationale: For r=2k source relations, the finite tag set has M=1+r(t+1)+sum binary one bits, t=ceil(log2 r). Only root and marker vertices loop; the root detector R(v,v)&exists nonself successor identifies precisely (a,rho). Each path length t+2 with loop-free internal positions is forced along one tagged layer chain; bit-marker tests at positions 1..t recover unique relation i, and only the layer-t to t+1 edge carries S_i(a,b). FO3 path formulas of O(t) syntax-tree size use a held endpoint and alternating rebindings of two scratch variable names; inner-scope marker tests use a spare name and close before further path traversal. For an arbitrary one-relation CoR circuit, the M² tagged blocks of every gate can be simulated with free Boolean and converse operations; each composition (G;H)_{uv}=union_w G_{uw};H_{wv} introduces at most M³ composition gates across all blocks, including shared subcircuits. The root-root block computes Uezato Phi_k on every finite base structure, so his actual Theorem 1.3, independently checked against primary full arXiv HTML, forces 2^(k-1)<=M³*g_(;). Thus a family of size O(klog k) needs 2^Omega(s/log s) composition gates. Inspected actual fixed_signature_gap_checker.py implementation and its finite sample scope; unlike source output, no unperformed run is claimed. Imported Theorem 1.3 is a published premise, not independently reproved.
